title: Terminal toolbar
name: Name
modeHint: Applies to every command button in this vault. Dynamic displays refresh independently in the background.
contract: stdout: one JSON object with a string value and optional message. Extra fields are ignored. Exit code 0 means the command ran successfully.
invalid: Check name, single-line command, intervals and unique mapping values.
mainWindow: Edit the toolbar in the main window.

errors.invalidJson: Invalid JSON: expected a string value and optional message.
errors.timeout: The refresh exceeded its time limit.
errors.outputLimit: The background command produced too much output.
errors.failed: Could not execute the action. Check the connection and whether a fullscreen application is running.

dynamicHint: Your value mappings determine the icon, color and text. The returned value can be anything you choose.
pathHint: Tab completes paths such as ~/.local/share/script.sh or bash /path/script.sh. Shift+Tab leaves the field.
pathUnavailable: Connect via SSH with SFTP support to browse server files.
pathBusy: Another path request is running. Try again.
pathTruncated: Only part of this directory is shown. Enter a more specific path.
pathExistsExecutable: File exists; executable mode bits are set. Effective access depends on the SSH user.
pathExists: File exists. For shell scripts without executable permission, use bash /path/script.sh.
